answer: Proof of Agent networks thwart Sybil swarms by tying identity to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint an identity, an agent locks collateral in a vault where bonding costs scale exponentially (O(k^n)) with swarm size, creating an insurmountable capital canyon. Any revoked identity leaves behind a slashed relic, making mass puppet creation economically unviable through exponential capital exhaustion.
